column1: What is the maximum allowable slope for a pedestrian accessibility ramp under BP 344?
column2: 1:12 (8.33%). A level landing of at least $1.50\text{m}$ length is required every $6.00\text{m}$ of horizontal run. [BP 344 Rule II]

column1: What are the standard heights required for BP 344 dual handrails on ramps and stairs?
column2: $0.70\text{m}$ ($700\text{mm}$) and $0.90\text{m}$ ($900\text{mm}$) above the floor level. [BP 344 Rule II]

column1: What is the minimum clear width required for an accessible door opening under BP 344?
column2: $0.80\text{m}$ ($800\text{mm}$), measured between the face of the door and the door stop with the door open $90^\circ$. [BP 344 Rule II]

column1: What are the standard dimensions for a standard perpendicular off-street car parking slot under PD 1096?
column2: $2.50\text{m} \times 5.00\text{m}$ (Minimum clear width = $2.50\text{m}$). [PD 1096 NBCP Table VII.5]

column1: What are the standard dimensions for an accessible (PWD) parking slot under BP 344?
column2: $3.70\text{m} \times 5.00\text{m}$ (Includes a $1.20\text{m}$ clear walkway alongside). [BP 344 Rule III]

column1: What is the Maximum Allowable Percentage of Site Occupancy (PSO) for an Inside Lot in an R-1 residential zone without a firewall?
column2: 50% (The Total Open Space within Lot [TOSL] must be at least 50%). [PD 1096 NBCP Table VII.1]

column1: What is the Maximum Allowable Percentage of Site Occupancy (PSO) for an Inside Lot in a C-2 commercial zone without a firewall?
column2: 75% (The Total Open Space within Lot [TOSL] must be at least 25%). [PD 1096 NBCP Table VII.1]

column1: What is the minimum clear turning diameter required for a wheelchair in accessible toilet stalls?
column2: $1.50\text{m}$ ($1,500\text{mm}$) diameter turning circle. [BP 344 Rule II]

column1: For a simply supported beam with a UDL w over span L, what is each support reaction and the maximum moment?
column2: R = wL/2 each; Mmax = wL²/8 at midspan. [STATICS-FUNDAMENTALS]

column1: A 5 m beam carries a 30 kN point load at 2.0 m from the left support. What is Mmax (not the PL/4 formula)?
column2: M = (reaction left) × 2.0 = 18 × 2 = 36 kN·m. PL/4 = 37.5 is the center-load trap. [STATICS-FUNDAMENTALS Ex.2]

column1: What is axial deformation δ for an axially loaded member?
column2: δ = PL/(AE). Units: N·mm/(mm²·N/mm²) = mm. [STRENGTH-OF-MATERIALS]

column1: What is the bending stress formula and what is c?
column2: σ = Mc/I; c = distance to the extreme fiber = h/2 (not full depth). [STRENGTH-OF-MATERIALS]

column1: In the method of joints, what do you assume about unknown member forces, and what does a negative answer mean?
column2: Assume tension (arrows pulling away from joint); negative result = compression (state it, not an error). [STRENGTH-OF-MATERIALS]

column1: Stiffness factor k for a member with far end fixed vs pinned?
column2: 4EI/L (fixed far end); 3EI/L (pinned far end). [MOMENT-DISTRIBUTION-WORKED-EXAMPLE]

column1: When does a rigid frame sway, and how is the correction factor k found?
column2: Sways when geometry/loading/support is unsymmetric; k = R/R′ from the shear equation (horizontal equilibrium of column base shears). [FRAME-ANALYSIS-WITH-SIDESWAY]

column1: Lumen-method fixture count formula?
column2: N = (E × A)/(Φ_lamp × CU × LLF); round UP. [MEPFS-WORKED-CALCULATIONS]

column1: Sabine reverberation time (SI)? What's the trap?
column2: RT60 = 0.161·V/A (m³); 0.05 for feet — never mix. [MEPFS-WORKED-CALCULATIONS]

column1: Name the 6 National Artists for Architecture (with years).
column2: Nakpil 1973 · Antonio 1976 · Locsin 1990 · Santos 2006 · Zaragoza 2014 · Mañosa 2018. [PHILIPPINE-ARCHITECTURE-HISTORY]

column1: CCP, PICC, NAIA 1 → which architect? (Not Coconut Palace!)
column2: Leandro Locsin (floating volume). Coconut Palace = Mañosa. [PHILIPPINE-ARCHITECTURE-HISTORY]

column1: Anatomy of the bahay na bato (climate response): zaguan, volada, ventanilla, capiz.
column2: Stone lower (zaguan) + timber upper; volada = cantilevered shaded gallery; ventanilla = below-window vent; capiz = translucent sliding window — passive tropical masterclass. [TROPICAL-DESIGN + PH-CASE-STUDIES]

column1: Primary passive cooling strategy in warm-humid PH?
column2: Cross-ventilation + shading (humidity defeats evaporative cooling; airflow is the mechanism). Orient openings ~90° to prevailing wind. [TROPICAL-DESIGN-PHILIPPINES]

column1: BERDE vs Philippine Green Building Code — voluntary or mandatory?
column2: BERDE = voluntary rating (PHGBC); PGBC = mandatory referral code of PD 1096 (DPWH 2015, thresholds by building type/area — verify). [PHILIPPINE-GREEN-BUILDING]

column1: CLUP vs Zoning Ordinance?
column2: CLUP = the plan (vision/land-use, 10–20 yr); ZO = the regulatory ordinance derived from it (zones, uses, densities). Building permits rely on the ZO. [CLUP-AND-ZONING-PROCESS]

column1: Order the 12-step CLUP process (abbreviated).
column2: Organize → stakeholders → vision → analyze → goals → thrust/strategies → draft → public hearing → adopt → draft ZO → approve ZO → implement/monitor. [CLUP-AND-ZONING-PROCESS]

column1: Curtain wall: structural or non-structural? What loads does it carry?
column2: Non-structural — carries only its own weight + wind; transfers to frame via anchors; never floor loads. [BT5-CURTAIN-WALLS]

column1: Pre-tensioning vs post-tensioning — timing and transfer mechanism?
column2: Pre = tendons tensioned BEFORE concrete (transfer by bond, plant/precast); Post = stressed AFTER hardening (transfer by anchorage/bearing, site); ducts grouted for bonded systems. [BT5-CURTAIN-WALLS + BT3-4]

column1: Under RA 10066, what status do works by a National Artist automatically receive?
column2: Important Cultural Property (ICP) — unless declared a National Cultural Treasure. [RA-10066-HERITAGE-ACT-SUMMARY]

column1: What is PRECUP and is registration mandatory?
column2: Philippine Registry of Cultural Property (§14) — national inventory; mandatory for NCTs/landmarks/ICPs/heritage zones; voluntary for private owners. [RA-10066-HERITAGE-ACT-SUMMARY]

column1: The 3 structural innovations that made Gothic height/light possible (and what they replaced).
column2: Pointed arch (less thrust, variable spans) + ribbed vault (replaced barrel/groin) + flying buttress (transfers thrust outward → walls open). [HOA-GOTHIC-PERIOD-MODULE]

column1: Le Corbusier's 5 points of architecture.
column2: Pilotis · roof garden · free plan · ribbon window · free façade. Manifesto = Villa Savoye. [HOA-MODERNISM + CASE-STUDIES]

column1: Bernini vs Borromini (one-line distinction)?
column2: Bernini = sculptural/theatrical (St. Peter's colonnade, baldachin); Borromini = daring geometric curves (San Carlo alle Quattro Fontane). [HOA-ROMANESQUE-BAROQUE]

column1: Floating volume over a reflecting pool = which PH building/architect?
column2: CCP — Leandro Locsin (1969): massive volume hovering on pilotis, tropical-modernist response. [PHILIPPINE-ARCHITECTURE + CASE-STUDIES]

column1: How many CHB per m² of wall (theoretical vs with waste)?
column2: ~12.5 blocks/m² theoretical (400×200 face + 10 mm joints); ~13/m² with ~5% waste (PH practice). [PHILIPPINE-CONSTRUCTION-MATERIALS]

column1: What is the occupant load factor for classrooms under RA 9514 (Revised Fire Code of the Philippines)?
column2: $1.80\text{ sqm per person}$ (net area). [RA 9514 Sec. 10.2.5.2]

column1: What is the occupant load factor for concentrated assembly spaces with chairs/auditorium seating?
column2: $0.65\text{ sqm per person}$ (net area). [RA 9514 Sec. 10.2.5.2]

What is the maximum allowable travel distance to an exit in a building WITH an approved automatic fire sprinkler system?

column1: Who were the principal architects of the Parthenon in Athens, Greece?
column2: Ictinus and Callicrates (with Phidias as master sculptor). [HOA 1]

column1: What architectural term describes the slight convex curvature applied to Greek Doric columns to correct the optical illusion of concavity?
column2: Entasis. [HOA 1 / TOA 1]

column1: What is the defining structural innovation that allowed the Byzantine dome of Hagia Sophia to transition onto a square ground plan?
column2: Pendentives (triangular spherical masonry vaults). [HOA 2]

column1: What is the maximum bending moment ($M_{max}$) formula for a simply supported beam of length $L$ carrying a uniformly distributed load $w$?
column2: $M_{max} = \frac{w L^2}{8}$ (occurs at midspan). [Statics / Structures 1]

column1: What is the maximum midspan bending moment formula for a simply supported beam carrying a single concentrated point load $P$ at center?
column2: $M_{max} = \frac{P L}{4}$. [Statics / Structures 1]

column1: What is the flexural bending stress formula ($\sigma$) in terms of moment $M$ and section modulus $S$?
column2: $\sigma = \frac{M \cdot c}{I} = \frac{M}{S}$. [Strength of Materials]

column1: What is the minimum slope required for horizontal plumbing drainage pipes $\le 100\text{mm}$ ($4\text{ inch}$) diameter under the Plumbing Code?
column2: $2.0\%$ ($20\text{mm per meter}$ or $1/4\text{ inch per foot}$). [National Plumbing Code]

column1: What is the standard refrigeration cooling capacity equivalent of 1 Ton of Refrigeration (TR)?
column2: $12,000\text{ BTU/hr} = 3.517\text{ kW}$. [Utilities 3 / HVAC]
